title: I Vibe coded this Wreckfest + Death Rally clone in 24 days
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
This is day 24 of Brutal Derby, my destruction derby / vehicle combat game.

24 cars with physics.

Vehicle deformation and destruction.

Bullet impacts.

Breakable objects.

Way too many particle effects.

3D crowds and spatial audio.

Weapons.

Multiple arenas and tracks.

And somehow it currently runs at around 60–100 FPS in 4K on my RTX 3070.

Most of the development loop has basically been:

add something stupid → lose FPS → optimize → regain FPS → add something even more stupid

10/10 would vibe code again.
